cases.name: clipboard history / cloud sync
cases.expected: record observable behaviour; product must not claim exclusion
cases.observed: not exercised automatically: Win+V history requires the WinRT Clipboard history API or manual observation; the borrowed copy is produced by the target app and may enter history/cloud sync. Product copy text must state this (PLAN 3.1).

notes: Target: WinForms RichTextBox fixture (Ctrl+C) and WPF PasswordBox (ignores Ctrl+C). Racing/holding processes are harness fixtures.
Snapshot helper budget counts from the helper's ready signal; helper process start is reported separately in production by the long-lived selection helper.
